channel.title: Crypto Readout
channel.description: Crypto Readout reports on Bitcoin, Ethereum and altcoin markets, DeFi protocols, exchanges, stablecoins, network upgrades and crypto regulation worldwide.

item.title: USDC Bridge Transfers Between Your Own Wallets
item.description: Is bridging USDC to another chain a taxable event? Usually no when the same USDC moves to your own wallet, though swaps and crypto gas fees can change the tax result.

item.title: Yield Optimizer Revenue Comes From Harvest Fees
item.description: How do yield optimizers make money? They mainly take a performance fee from harvested rewards, then split it among the protocol, contributors and token stakers.

item.title: How do you verify a Beefy vault deposit on-chain?
item.description: Beefy app vault deposits mint mooTokens as your share: approve the token, deposit, then verify your balance and calculate its value from price per share.

item.title: Aave Liquidity Index: Read Your aToken Growth
item.description: The Aave liquidity index tracks supplier interest as a shared multiplier; compare today’s index with your deposit index to calculate aToken growth.

item.title: What Is Liquidity Risk in DeFi Lending? Know When You Can Exit
item.description: Liquidity risk in DeFi lending is the chance you cannot withdraw now because borrowers have used the pool's idle funds, even when your claim remains intact.

item.title: EU proposes sanctions on Russia-linked crypto networks
item.description: The Commission’s proposed 22nd sanctions package would target crypto and payment networks in Russia and countries helping it evade EU measures.

item.title: What Changes for Bridge Funds at Each Rollup Stage?
item.description: Rollup stage 0 vs stage 1 vs stage 2 changes who controls bridge funds: operators, a proof system with a council override, or code with a longer exit window.

item.title: EU’s 22nd Russia sanctions package targets crypto networks
item.description: The European Commission proposed restrictions on Russian banks and crypto networks, aiming to curb war financing and close routes used to evade EU sanctions.

item.title: LP locked percentage: How to read pull risk by pool
item.description: How to read the LP locked percentage on rugcheck: separate burned LP from time-locked LP, then use each pool’s liquidity and unlock date to judge what can be pulled.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russia-linked crypto networks and 60 banks
item.description: The European Commission’s 22nd Russia sanctions package would target crypto and payment networks, 60 banks and Russian sports participation if all EU states approve.

item.title: How to Use RenBridge With MetaMask and a Bitcoin Wallet: The Mint
item.description: How to use RenBridge with MetaMask and a Bitcoin wallet: send BTC to a gateway, wait for confirmations, then pay ETH gas to mint renBTC on Ethereum.

item.title: Swap Slippage: When to Use Auto or Custom
item.description: Auto slippage vs custom slippage: use auto for liquid major pairs, and set a custom value for transfer-tax, thin-token or stablecoin swaps needing a tighter floor.

item.title: Why a Revoked Approval Stays Listed Until Indexing Catches Up
item.description: A blockchain indexer in crypto apps reads contract events and makes them searchable, so approval lists can update after the next indexing pass on-chain.

item.title: How to Sweep Stablecoins Onto One Chain
item.description: Learn how to consolidate stablecoins scattered across several chains: choose a destination, use CCTP for native USDC and bridge other balances worth the fees.

item.title: How to Restake a Solo Ethereum Validator With EigenLayer
item.description: Native restaking routes a solo Ethereum validator’s withdrawal credentials to an EigenPod, then proves its stake so it can secure selected AVSs.

item.title: What Details Bridge Support Needs When Funds Go Missing
item.description: What details does bridge support need for a missing transfer? Send the source hash, both chains, addresses, token, amount, UTC time, status and message ID.

item.title: Ethereum speed-up vs zkSync Era: what pending means
item.description: Why can't you speed up a pending zkSync Era transaction like on Ethereum? Era ignores priority tips, so check the explorer and refresh MetaMask instead.

item.title: Token Spender Address Checks Before Revocation
item.description: To verify a token spender address before revoking approval, match its full address to trusted project documentation on the same chain, then inspect that chain’s explorer.

item.title: How to Set TWAP Parts and Timing for a Token Sale
item.description: Choose a TWAP part count and interval by checking price impact per part, then balance pool recovery time against the network cost of each execution.

item.title: OKX and ICE open tokenized securities venue with 113 assets
item.description: OKX and ICE opened a tokenized securities venue with 113 assets confirmed for phased listing, while 67 companies objected to share tokens, testing issuer control.
